Echoes Live" by Nick Mason's Saucerful of Secrets is a live album capturing the band's performance of Pink Floyd's iconic 23-minute track "Echoes," originally from the 1971 album Meddle. Released in 2025 on the Legacy label, this recording was made at the Centennial Hall in Frankfurt, Germany, on August 1, 2024. The album showcases the band's dedication to early Pink Floyd material, emphasizing a rock style that blends atmospheric passages with dynamic shifts in mood and instrumentation, reflecting the complexity and depth of the original composition.

This live rendition holds a significant place in Nick Mason's Saucerful of Secrets' discography as it follows their 2019 debut tours and live album Live at the Roundhouse (2020), further cementing their mission to revive and celebrate Pink Floyd's pre-Dark Side of the Moon era. The undertaking of performing "Echoes" live was a notable challenge due to the track's intricate structure, but the band received widespread critical acclaim for their interpretation, with reviewers highlighting the performance's intensity and fidelity to the spirit of the original.

Critically, "Echoes Live" was praised for its sound quality and musicianship, featuring a half-speed mastered vinyl release with an exclusive etched B-side design for Record Store Day 2025. Steven Wilson's Dolby ATMOS mix added a modern sonic dimension to the recording, enhancing the immersive experience. The album was well received by both critics and fans, with live shows selling out and the performance described as awe-inspiring, underscoring the band's success in bridging Pink Floyd's early experimental work with contemporary live rock presentation.
